Subject: Re: Freelance Project Contract Questions

Hi Eliana,

Thanks for reviewing the contract and for your feedback. I appreciate you bringing these points up so we can ensure the terms work well for both of us.

Regarding the payment terms, I understand your preference for net-30. Let’s discuss this further to see if we can find a middle ground that aligns with your standard workflow while meeting our internal requirements.

As for the non-compete clause, I agree that it’s important for the terms to be equitable. I am open to discussing adjustments to make it more reasonable and specific to the scope of this project.

Let’s schedule a brief call later this week to go over these details. Please let me know what days and times work best for you.

Best regards,

Ms. Adams
